up: Identify the parent compound CHEMBL493620 and all its salt forms using the molecule hierarchy. Retrieve bioactivity records for these compounds against target CHEMBL3879801. Filter for activities where the standard type is IC50. Return the ChEMBL identifier of the tested compound, the standard IC50 value, the standard units, the canonical SMILES, the PubMed ID, and the DOI.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT child.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, act.standard_value, act.standard_units, cs.canonical_smiles, d.pubmed_id, d.doi FROM molecule_dictionary parent JOIN molecule_hierarchy mh ON mh.parent_molregno = parent.molregno JOIN molecule_dictionary child ON child.molregno = mh.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON cr.molregno = child.molregno JOIN activities act ON act.record_id = cr.record_id JOIN assays a ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON td.tid = a.tid LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON cs.molregno = child.molregno LEFT JOIN docs d ON d.doc_id = act.doc_id WHERE parent.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL493620' AND td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3879801' AND act.standard_type = 'IC50'
